expectations.text: Explains CMMC Level 2 correctly: 110 security requirements drawn from NIST SP 800-171 (Rev 2) protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), codified in the 32 CFR Part 170 program rule
expectations.evidence: Response correctly states 110 requirements from NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 protecting CUI, but never mentions 32 CFR Part 170 anywhere in the response — the codifying program rule is entirely absent.

expectations.text: States the July 13, 2026 program status: DoD suspended CMMC Phase 2 — including the C3PAO third-party assessment requirements due in new contracts from November 10, 2026 — pending a 60-day CMMC Reform Task Force review (report due ≈ September 13, 2026); in the interim only Level 1 (Self) or Level 2 (Self) may be designated, and 32 CFR 170 / DFARS clauses remain law (suspension is policy, not repeal)
expectations.evidence: No mention anywhere of the July 13, 2026 suspension, the Reform Task Force, or the interim Level 1/2 self-assessment-only designation. The response treats full C3PAO certification as a live, currently-required track ('Most contracts... will require the third-party certification assessment').

expectations.text: Explains prerequisite mechanics that CONTINUE unchanged: SPRS score submission (Basic Assessment against 800-171), SSP requirement, annual senior-official affirmation, and DFARS 252.204-7012 obligations (incl. 72-hour DIBNET incident reporting)
expectations.evidence: SPRS and SSP are covered, but there is no mention of the 72-hour DIBNET incident reporting obligation under DFARS 7012 anywhere in the response, and 'annual affirmations' is only mentioned in the context of a 3-year C3PAO certification cycle, not tied to the ongoing self-assessment/SPRS affirmation duty.

expectations.text: Gives a realistic readiness timeline for a first-timer (commonly 9-18 months of remediation) and advises HOLDING the remediation course because the task-force outcome may restore third-party assessment on short notice
expectations.evidence: The 9-18 month timeline is present ('Total, realistically: 9-18 months from a cold start to certification'), but there is no advice about holding course pending a task-force outcome, since the response never mentions the suspension or task force at all.

expectations.text: Recommends concrete first steps: scope where CUI lives, consider an enclave, gap-assess against 800-171, build SSP and POA&M — with C3PAO scheduling framed as paused/on-hold rather than an immediate booking
expectations.evidence: Scoping, a 'CUI enclave' (explicitly named), gap assessment, and SSP/POA&M are all recommended. However, step 7 explicitly instructs the firm to actively 'Engage a C3PAO... Contact an accredited C3PAO from the Cyber-AB Marketplace' as a near-term action item — the opposite of framing C3PAO scheduling as paused/on-hold.
